children.text: Participants
ThinkByte: Pavan, Charan Kumar
Superk: Siddharth Mutyala
Key Takeaways

The team discussed prioritizing the review of the influencer plan, including shortlisting influencers, content creation, and budget planning, followed by social media calendar and paid marketing strategies.

There was a focus on analyzing the effectiveness of awareness campaigns, particularly comparing the impact of ads on customer behavior and footfall growth, without emphasizing cost comparisons with pamphlets.
The influencer strategy involves creating teaser videos with large influencers and planning for 100 videos with various themes, while considering efficient communication methods with influencers.
The team emphasized the importance of integrating paid media strategies with influencer content to maximize impact, suggesting a need for a clear plan for the next 20 days.
A comprehensive marketing strategy was proposed, including the use of WhatsApp, IVR, and SMS channels, to ensure all marketing activities are aligned and tracked in a unified calendar.
Influencer Plan Review
Need for clear strategy defining content expectations, budget allocations for influencers.
Prioritize influencer plan, review budget planning, SOPs for collaboration, payment processes.
Discussion on prioritizing influencer plan, focusing on content type, budget planning, and initial shortlisting of influencers.
SOP Review and Sharing
Identified need for workflow adjustments, timely updates to ensure processes align with current objectives.
The team focused on reviewing and making changes to the Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to improve workflow efficiency.
Decided to share SOP documents among team members for collaborative review, updates.
Comprehensive Marketing Calendar and Strategy
Develop a unified marketing strategy integrating content, paid media, and local marketing for cohesive execution.
Creation of a comprehensive marketing calendar integrating all channels and strategies for coordinated execution.
Need for a unified marketing plan integrating various channels and strategies for better coordination and execution.
Campaign Metrics Analysis
Need comprehensive data analysis to determine impact of paid media on customer engagement, store visits.
Conduct detailed analysis on customer engagement, store visits, develop actionable insights for campaign adjustments.
Ongoing analysis of campaign metrics to assess effectiveness of paid media strategies.
Paid Marketing Strategy
Need to compare and evaluate effectiveness of paid media versus traditional marketing methods like pamphlets.
Focus on metrics like customer engagement, conversion rates to evaluate campaign success, develop clear budget strategy.
Emphasis on prioritizing paid media campaigns for effective customer engagement and conversion.
Influencer Content and Budget
Challenges creating engaging content while staying within budget constraints.
Focus on broad scripts, budget planning, influencer collaboration to maximize campaign reach, effectiveness.
Development of influencer content strategies, budget allocations to maximize engagement and reach.
Social Media Calendar Planning
Review of social media calendar to ensure aligned content flow and integration with influencer, paid media strategies.
Social media calendar plan be aligned with content, paid media strategies ensure seamless content flow.
Need for integrated approach social media, influencer, paid media strategies improve coherence, effectiveness.
Content Creation and Repository
Build repository of content, static and dynamic, for social media and influencer campaigns to ensure readiness and consistency.
Development of a content repository for social media, influencer campaigns to ensure consistency, readiness.
Need consistent, engaging content aligned with marketing objectives, ready for deployment as needed.
Content Guidelines and Brand Alignment
Creation of content guidelines to ensure messaging aligns with brand identity and campaign objectives.
Provide influencers with content guidelines, brand assets maintain consistency, ensure alignment with brand messaging.
Need for content alignment with brand identity to maintain consistent messaging and aesthetics.
UGC Contest and Employee Involvement
Development of User-Generated Content initiatives involving employees to increase engagement.
Conduct UGC contests among employees, incentivize participation, creativity to boost engagement, content creation.
Need to increase engagement through creative UGC initiatives leveraging employee involvement.
SOP, Payment, Approval Processes
Need clear SOPs for collaboration, approval processes ensure efficient execution, payment.
Establishment of SOPs and payment processes for seamless influencer collaboration and content approval.
Develop SOPs detailing collaboration guidelines, payment processes, approval workflows for influencer partnerships.
E-commerce Integration and Promotion
Need to increase e-commerce adoption among existing customers as part of overall marketing strategy.
Integration of e-commerce strategies with marketing efforts to enhance customer engagement and conversion.
Develop content, campaigns to promote e-commerce features, enhance adoption among existing customers.
Action Items
Speaker 1
Finalize the content plan by today or tomorrow to identify any gaps and consider utilizing influencers with good content creation skills but limited reach.
Speaker 2
Share the update with the team.
Send the report after completing the working session to close the metaverse access today.
Ensure that influencers with Youtube channels also post on their Instagram and Whatsapp broadcast channels without additional payment. Track their posts on Youtube by tagging the company.
Speaker 4
Develops paid media strategies and coordinates with team members.
Pain Point
The video has not gained any reach yet.
The auxiliary video for PC is not displaying correctly, particularly in vertical format.
Expressed concern about the difficulty of completing a task that required producing 100 videos in one week.
Lack of clarity regarding the subscription process.
